result.title: From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems
result.summary: The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个面向边缘 AI 的因果跨层自愈框架，持续采集传感器健康、推理不确定性、处理器计数器、功耗与热状态等多源遥测，用带时序信息的因果引擎推断异常最可能的来源并量化诊断不确定性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其从多源证据中定位异常来源并量化归因不确定性的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分视觉证据缺失、latent 状态错误与监督问题提供概念借鉴，但领域相距较远，映射到推理期状态尚需核查。
